pr_body:
This removes the deprecated params `allow_no_datafeeds` and `allow_no_jobs` from v8 rest APIs.

The params still exist and are deprecated in v7 REST APIs.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/60732

review_comment: yes, that is what we want. later when the support for RestApiVersion.V_7 is removed we will be able to track this down and remove the unwanted if branch

All of this tells me we need a generic "RestAPI Param parser util" or something where we can declare params, their compatibility, if they are deprecated, etc...

Seems like a good opportunity for a nice refactor.

yes, looks like some refactoring should be done.
We have a similar usecase - but simpler where we just ignore the value and there is no replacement - for INCLUDE_TYPE_NAME_PARAMETER
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/12ad399c488f0cc60e19b5e1b29c6d569cb4351a/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/rest/action/admin/indices/RestCreateIndexAction.java#L63

it is good for consistency, but so far we did not include cat apis in rest api compatibility.
In this case I feel it might be useful though
